aggressive_definition: Advanced disease at the time of diagnosis and high-grade disease; the high-grade cases were a subset of advanced cases. Exact stage and grade criteria were not specified in the abstract.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Two-thirds (n 525) of the cases had advanced disease at the time of diagnosis, and among these 170 had high-grade disease; 305 cases died (n 212 from prostate cancer) during follow-up through 2012.
study_design: Prospective nested case-control study within the Danish Diet, Cancer and Health cohort, with risk-set matching of each incident case to one control.
reason: The abstract analyzes incident total prostate cancer and aggressive incident subtypes defined as advanced disease at diagnosis and high-grade disease. It also reports postdiagnosis mortality analyses, which are survival endpoints rather than incidence. The source cohort contained 27,179 men, but the abstract does not directly state the total analytic nested case-control sample size.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Plasma Se was not associated with total or advanced prostate cancer risk, but higher Se levels were associated with a lower risk of high-grade disease (HR 0·77; 95 % CI 0·64, 0·94; P=0·009).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate explicitly concerns risk of high-grade prostate cancer, an aggressive incident endpoint, rather than total disease or postdiagnosis mortality.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
